indexAccumulationContract.start: index starts from startIndex, normally -1 for a packet entry sequence
indexAccumulationContract.expectedEntityIndexByLocalFormula: checked by comparing previousEntityIndex + indexDelta + 1 to boundary entityIndex

commandContract.commandPositionPlausibilitySignal: true only when readCounts are monotonic, within entityDataBitLength, and neighboring loops retain plausible entity index and command sequence under the same cursor model

payloadBitsContract.source: EntityPayloadSizeExtractor decodes varint payload sizes from CSVCMsg_PacketEntities.serializedEntities
payloadBitsContract.localUse: available when filtering or recovery/diagnostics are active; used as compact metadata and in bounded recovery paths, not as a universal cursor contract
payloadBitsContract.futureComparison: compare payloadBits to afterAction - afterCommand for entries with actual action read counts; never move cursor to enforce payloadBits in the probe

failureSurface.beforeIndex: cursor error before readUVarInt can change indexDelta, entityIndex, and subsequent command position
failureSurface.betweenIndexAndCommand: cursor error after index read can alter two-bit command interpretation
failureSurface.afterCommand: field-level decode/action consumption can alter next entry start without changing decoded command
